sampling_rule_for_partial_range: For parameters with published cluster-specific fitted ranges, sampling was restricted to an equal-weight categorical mixture across available cluster marginals (Additional file 1), with a uniform distribution within each reported interval. Cluster-component assignments were made independently for each parameter because joint parameter distributions and cross-parameter correlations were unavailable. Missing cluster marginals were not imputed. Generated parameter vectors do not represent reconstructed patient clusters or samples from the original fitted ensemble.
freeze_statement: This ensemble (vaughan_exploratory_ensemble_v1) was generated and admissibility-filtered using only mathematical/numerical criteria (solver success, finiteness, non-negativity beyond tolerance, no blow-up). No Helmy et al. 2011 data, value, or derived quantity was used in parameter sampling, cluster-marginal construction, initial-condition sampling, or admissibility filtering at any point up to and including this freeze.
